description: Reconciliation per bank account: every uploaded statement with its own opening and closing balance as printed, the books' balance at its end date, the difference and whether they agree (month by month), plus the unreconciled transaction count and the newest unreconciled lines. Use it for "does the bank agree?", "what was the closing balance in March?", before quoting any reconciliation difference, when the user asks to check the books against the bank statements, or about reconciliation progress. This tool only reads: to actually reconcile ("reconcile what you can", "match the receipts", "reconcile my bank") call auto_match_receipts, which does the matching. Never say everything is reconciled without a result from this tool, get_attention or auto_match_receipts. Never say you cannot read balances off statements. Each statement row carries period_start, period_end, opening_balance, closing_balance, book_balance_at_end, difference, agrees and document_id. Pass bank_account_id to look at one account. It also gives the link to download the reconciliation report (PDF or Excel), the report to give an accountant who asks for one.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.
